screening_method: FIA-term title/field filter of 1082 plus Zapata-de la Cruz 2026 plus two scoping papers. Dual independent screening of all 1082 was not completed.
notes: Search date lock of September 2026 was overridden by the PI on 19 August 2026.
1889 = PubMed 423 + Embase 959 + Web of Science 432 + ScienceDirect 75 before deduplication. Cochrane CENTRAL (10) is protocol-supplementary and is not in the 1889.
ScienceDirect: full protocol tak() string exceeded Elsevier's max 8 Boolean connectors per field. Condensed TAK query returned 88 hits; protocol article-type filter (research + review) left 75.
Of 75 ScienceDirect records, 61 matched PubMed/Embase/WoS and 14 were unique to ScienceDirect.
Cochrane Advanced Search: 0 CDSR reviews, 10 CENTRAL trials.
PubMed+Embase+WoS+ScienceDirect = 1889 retrieved; 807 duplicates removed leaving 1082 unique bibliographic records.
Dual independent screening of all 1082 unique records was not completed.
OpenAlex and Crossref were run as public indexes; Crossref is not added into the 1889 total.
Scopus was not searched (not on University of Toledo A-Z Databases).
Quantitative synthesis: Chaiyo 2022, Zapata-de la Cruz 2026, Ghogre 2021, Zuroidah 2022, Pohekar 2017.
